lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a grid of high-luminance anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, showing high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side and cast shadows on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of high-luminance blobs localized within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated along the anterior margin and dorsal apex.
